caption: A checkerboard card is reflected in the bowl of a shiny spoon, and as the spoon turns slowly the reflected pattern stretches and shifts.

sa.check: A checkerboard card is reflected in the bowl of a spoon.
The reflected pattern stretches and shifts.
The spoon turns first and the pattern shifts with it.

pc.expect: The reflected pattern is small and warped by the curve and stays inside the metal.
pc.fail: It is flat and undistorted; or larger than the spoon's bowl; or it appears outside the metal.

pc.expect: The pattern changes with the spoon's angle and only then.
pc.fail: It stays fixed as the spoon turns; or it shifts with the spoon still; or it shows a different card.
It slides; or turns by itself; or lifts.

pc.expect: The spoon is rigid polished metal.
pc.fail: It bends; or its surface ripples; or it goes dull.
The spoon duplicates; or the card vanishes; or the reflection becomes solid; or the hand passes through the spoon.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: The card's pattern and the table stay the same.
pc.fail: The card changes pattern; or the table changes; or the spoon changes shape.

note: The hand turning the spoon is the minimal trigger; the person is not judged.
